item.title: Fearless Signs Rock Band Archers + Band Shares Video for “The Dirt”
item.description: FEARLESS RECORDS WELCOMES ARCHERS TO THE LABEL’S GLOBAL ROSTER BAND SHARES VIDEO FOR NEW SINGLE + LABEL DEBUT “THE DIRT” — WATCH TOURING WITH NOTHING MORE THROUGH THE WINTER FEARLESS RECORDS is thrilled to welcome Wisconsin-based rock band ARCHERS — Nathanael Pulley [vocals], Ben Koehler [guitar] and Grayson Mesarosh [drums] —to the label’s global roster. Today, the band, which has forged a deeply intense connection with its fans, shares the video for “THE DIRT,” its debut single for the label.

item.title: DA // SELF-TITLED DEBUT ALBUM LANDS THIS APRIL WITH NEW SINGLE OUT NOW
item.description: DA SELF-TITLED DEBUT ALBUM LANDS THIS APRIL WITH NEW SINGLE OUT NOW London heavy rock crew, DA, are gearing up to make their mark with the release of their self-titled debut album, DA, out Friday 10th April. The first taste of the record is their new single, Snake, which is out now. Check out the video here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NnFhwQYIJx8. Leaning into blistering guitars, powerful vocals, and a dark, atmospheric feel, DA bring together classic heavy-metal grit and a sharp modern edge
